question: Our CI script runs `npx doc-detective --input docs --no-auto-record` so runs don't make videos, but one spec still leaves an .mp4 under `.doc-detective/runs/<runId>/.../recordings/` every run. A teammate says the flag is broken in 5.x. Is it? What do I change so nothing gets auto-recorded?

facts.text: `--no-auto-record` sets `autoRecord` at the config level only.
A spec or test that sets `autoRecord: true` overrides the config level (test over spec over config), so that spec still records; the flag works as designed.
To stop it, remove `autoRecord: true` from that spec or its tests, or set it to `false` there.

must_not: `--no-auto-record` overrides `autoRecord` set in a spec or test.
The flag is broken or the behavior is a bug in Doc Detective 5.
A different flag or environment variable forces automatic recording off over spec- and test-level settings.

wrong.answer:
The flag only covers the default contexts. Use the stronger flag, which overrides every spec and test:

```bash
npx doc-detective --input docs --no-record
```

wrong.why: says the CLI flag wins over the spec
wrong.answer: Command-line flags always win over spec and test settings, so `--no-auto-record` should turn recording off everywhere. Your teammate is right: it's a 5.x bug. Set `"autoRecord": false` in `.doc-detective.json` as well until it's fixed.
The flag works. Videos in the run folder can also come from screenshots and reporters, so check that `autoScreenshot` is off too, and clear out `.doc-detective/` between runs.
